import urllib.request

for v in [1, 50, 100, 150, 200, 220, 222, 223, 226]:
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/unisave/P11801?version={v}&format=txt"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Python/urllib'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            lines = resp.read().decode().splitlines()
            gn_lines = [l for l in lines if l.startswith("GN")]
            print(f"v{v}: {gn_lines}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"v{v}: {e}")
